by: oio-1 session (Opus), step 5.3; to be appended by the integrator at the merge
title: One page of the Overseas Investment Office's decisions listing, filtered by year (www.linz.govt.nz/our-work/overseas-investment-regulation/decisions, HTML)

landmarks: the Drupal view `oi-investment-releases` with its exposed filters (search, year, applicant, type)
a table per release month headed 'Decisions in <Month YYYY>', columns Case number (a link to /decisions/<YYYY-MM>/<slug>), Applicant, Decision date (<time datetime>)
a pager: the current page (title="Current page", ?page=N, 0-based) and, before the last page, a 'Go to last page' link

signals_note: GET ...decisions?field_decision_date_value=YYYY&page=N through the fetch gate, 5 s apart; landed verbatim by hash. A page without the view's case-number column is not this shape.
notes: Seen 21 October 2026: 60 rows a page, newest decision first; no stated total, the pager states the last page. From 2017: 1,337 rows over 27 pages (2017 100, 2018 98, 2019 146, 2020 118, 2021 150, 2022 181, 2023 149, 2024 149, 2025 136, 2026 110), 1,318 pages of summary: a page carrying several case numbers is listed once per number. The unfiltered listing reaches back to 2005 (49 pages). The year filter is by decision date; the path's YYYY-MM is the release month. Type filter: Decision or Notification; the listing shows both. An applicant the office withholds is listed as 'Withheld under s9(2)(a) ... of the Official Information Act'.
applies_to: the office's decisions listing, from 21 October 2026
process: Recognise the page; a page not of this shape stops the pass (set aside).
One listed row per (summary page, case number): the slug and address, the case number, the applicant and date as listed; the three are the row's fingerprint.
The pass ends on the pager's last page; the office's count for the year is 60 a page then the last page's rows.
gates: Each year's distinct rows equal the rows its pages showed, and its pages the pager's statement (check.py).
on_fail: set the page aside; the pass resumes from it next run

by: oio-1 session (Opus), step 5.3; to be appended by the integrator at the merge
title: One Overseas Investment Office decision summary (a consent granted or declined), HTML

landmarks: a meta block <dl class="content__wider-col node__meta-grid"> with Applicant, Case number(s) (one <div class="clearfix"> per number), Decision date, Type 'Decision'
one table of headed rows (……) whose first heading is 'Decision'

signals_note: GET the summary's address from the listing, through the fetch gate, 5 s apart; landed verbatim by hash.
notes: Seen 21 October 2026 on 22 summaries, 2017 to 2026. Row headings vary in case and wording: Decision; Decision maker; Decision date; Pathway / Pathway(s) (from about 2020); Investment (once 'Investment[1]'); Consideration, Asset Value, Lease amount, Cost of Commencing Business; Applicant; Vendor / Vendors; Issuer; Background; More information (the applicant's lawyer, never read); Retrospective penalty; Attachments (decision report PDFs). The Decision cell: the outcome in bold, then the section. A party cell: each party's name in bold, a status after it ('(in receivership)'), then ownership lines ('Australia 87%', 'China, People's Republic of (97.18%)', 'Name, Country (50%)'); lines under one name are that party's, lines only after the last of several names are shared. 'Withheld under s9(2)(a) ... of the Official Information Act' replaces a name, a figure or the whole investment. The Investment gives street addresses of land, some of them homes: withheld from the views, held private (hard limit 15).
process: Recognise the page; set it aside whole if it is not the shape.

One decision row keyed by the page's slug: case numbers, type, outcome and section, decision maker, decision date, pathway, class of investment, the investment statement with street addresses and legal descriptions withheld (the statement as published to the private twin), areas as stated and in hectares, the money row as headed (a figure only under Consideration or a price, and only where one dollar figure is stated and nothing withheld), penalty, rationale (the Background's list items and its sentences naming a test or criterion).

One party row per bold name under Applicant / Consent holder, Vendor(s) and Issuer: name as published, status, the trust a trustee acts for, a company number only where printed beside the name, ownership origins and shares as stated.
A name the office withholds is withheld: the row stays, the name and its origins do not.
gates: Every listed row is a decision, a catch-log line or 'not captured' (check.py).
No withheld party shows a name; no street address or legal description in any published text (check.py).

by: oio-1 session (Opus), step 5.3; to be appended by the integrator at the merge
title: One notification of a transaction under an Overseas Investment Office standing consent, HTML

landmarks: the meta block with Type 'Notification' and, on some, 'Parent Decision / OI Case number'
one table of headed rows whose first heading is 'Notification'

notes: Seen 21 October 2026 on three notifications (2022, 2025, 2026). Case numbers carry the notification after a slash (202200239/2; the slug drops it). The Notification cell is 'Notification of a transaction under a Standing Consent' in bold then the section, or (2022) the section first with the schedule on a second line and no outcome. 'Notification number' ('2 of 15', '5 (of 27)'); 'Decision date' or 'Date'; 'Consent holder' in place of Applicant. A notification is not a decision: granted is empty.
process: As oio-decision-summary; the outcome is empty where the cell begins with the section.
The notification number and the parent case as stated.
